card.name: The word for after a noun or verb
card.fires_on: The word "for" (sometimes "performed") right after a noun or verb phrase, where it introduces a purpose or recipient such as review, reviewers, a visit or someone. Seen in general web text such as site notices and article pages.

modes.label: Purpose "for" after an action
modes.description: "for" follows a verb or noun phrase and introduces what the action is meant for.
modes.example: your modifications will be sent to our editors<< for>> review.

modes.label: Recipient or audience "for"
modes.description: "for" names who or what a service, news item or notice is aimed at.
modes.example: Entertainment and lifestyle news<< for>> Maui, Hawaii and the surrounding Islands.

modes.label: Performed for a case
modes.description: The verb "performed" is followed by a case or target phrase.
modes.example: A similar analysis can be<< performed>> for the general case of the multivariate

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like reason and reasons after "for", so the text moves on to other kinds of continuation.
card.plain: It fires on "for" when it means for the purpose of or for the benefit of something.
